title: WooCommerce Management
meta: A starter sprint of listings, order handling, updates and upkeep for your WooCommerce store. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WooCommerce management, a first round of upkeep
overview: This is a fixed starter sprint, so you can see how we work before committing to more. We back up your store, update WordPress, WooCommerce and plugins on staging, update product listings you give us, check orders and stock for errors and fix what we find. You get a plain report of what was done. Ongoing monthly management is quoted separately if you want us to carry on.

faq: Is this a monthly management plan?
No. It is a one-time sprint with a fixed scope. If you want ongoing management, we quote a monthly plan separately once we know how much your store needs.
Will you handle my customer emails and support?
Not in this sprint. We focus on the store itself: listings, updates, orders and fixes. Customer service can be quoted separately if you need it.
A WordPress administrator user and, if possible, hosting access. You add us as a user, we never ask for passwords, and you can remove us when the sprint ends.
Can you edit prices and stock in bulk?
Yes. Send a spreadsheet and we update products by import, then spot check. We confirm the file layout with you first so nothing is overwritten by mistake.
